Name: (CP) Darker Dirt and Cliffs Temporary Fix for 1.6
Author: Nessephanie
Description:
[b]Welcome:[/b]
[list]
[*]I absolutely love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2931]Darker Dirt and Cliffs[/url]﻿ and I have a hard time playing the game without it, and i really wanted to play 1.6. So I decided to edit the new tiles to match as well as I could, to use temporarily for myself, and thought maybe others would like to use it too.
[/list][list]
[*]Please let me know if I've missed anything! I don't have any 100% saves so it's possible. I did my best to find everything but if you find something I missed (or messed up haha) please comment with screenshots!
[/list][list]
[*]Hopefully Nanomatic will update and this won't be needed for long, but I'm wiling to keep working on it as long as it is!
[/list][b]
Instructions[/b]:
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2931]Darker Dirt and Cliffs[/url]﻿ from Nanomatic.
[*]Install this mod on it's own, you need both folders for this to work, with the fix loading second.
[/list]
[b]Works with:[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url] and with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20698]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor Temporary fix for 1.6[/url]﻿, but it[b] needs to load after[/b] those two and the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2931]Darker dirt and Cliffs[/url]﻿.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635]Blue Grass Recolor[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ - There is a separate additional file to fix the edges of the waterfalls if using with SVE.

[/list]
